DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Jejunal or Ileal)

The X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with no gas in the rectum strongly suggests a complete obstruction rather than simple atresia, which usually presents with gas in the rectum. I need to confirm if there is a palpable mass in the abdomen or if the baby has vomited bilious (green) fluid, as this will guide our surgical planning.
